summary: Frontend-only verification of the new Aftersales 'AI Assistant' sub-tab. All 7 acceptance criteria pass end-to-end against Claude via /api/crm/v2/aftersales/ai/assistant using AlphaCo (Site A) PF-MA-CMPDEMO as the primary contract. Fact sheet, three modes (summary/email/question), copy-flip, and disabled-state gating all behave as specified. Figures in generated text are traceable to the fact sheet (£4,200.00 annual, Gold, £350.00 next invoice on 2026-10-01).

issues: Console hydration warning: <span> nested inside <option> for the contract dropdown (line ~1864 of AftersalesApp.js). Cosmetic React warning caused by the visual-edit wrapper, not user-visible, but should be cleaned up.

critical_code_review_comments: canGen guard in AIAssistantTab uses `emailType !== 'general'`, matching EMAIL_TYPES id 'general' whose label is 'Other (use my instruction)'. Wording in the task spec says "when email type is 'Other'" — implementation is correct; just a naming mismatch between id and label that could confuse future readers.
Contract dropdown rendering triggers a hydration warning (<span> inside <option>). Wrap dynamic content differently or strip data-ve wrappers for option children.
